translation.name: Dillꞌ wen dillꞌ   Kob C̱he   Jesucrístonaꞌ

book.name: Apocalipsis
book.title: Jesucrístona' bliile' Juanna' c̱he diika' zi' gak

content: Bayix̱aa bchej ḻoo nisdo'na'
Na' ble'id' bchej ḻoo nisdo'na' to bayix̱' llia gall yic̱hjb na' zi shi ḻozb. Na' to to ḻozba' zoan twej corona, na' to to yic̱hjba' llian leba' daa zeji chon kwim ka Chioza'.
Na' bayix̱aa ble'id', nakb katekzə bell tigr
, na' ṉi'a naba' nakan ka ṉi'a na' oso, na' cho'aba' nakan ka c̱he bell lión. Na' bayix̱' xṉana' be'b ḻeb yeḻ' wak na' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱heba' kwenc̱he iṉabia'b.
To yic̱hj bayix̱aa zoalejan byaljan to we' daa nan guetib, na' we'na' biyakin. Na' yog' beṉ' yell-lioka' bibangakile' na' bengake' bayix̱aa txen.
Na' be'la'ogake' bayix̱' xṉana', daa be' yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱heba' bayix̱aa nak ka bell tigr, na' ḻekzka' be'la'ogake' bell tigra', nagake': ―Kono zoa sto ka bayix̱ii, na' kono so saki tiḻ-lem.
Na' kono bsej bllon be'b dill' cha'sibə na' wṉeb zban c̱he Chioza', na' wṉabia'b c̱hopiyon beo'.
Wṉeb zban c̱he Chioza', na' biz ben wnab c̱he', na' c̱he yabana' gana' zoe', na' c̱he beṉ'ka' zoa yabana'.

Na' gok lo na'b til-ḻem beṉ'ka' nak lall' na' Chioza', na' bem ḻegake' gan. Na' ḻekzka' gok lo na'b iṉabia'b lao yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' za' yog' dia, beṉ' lle' yog' yell, beṉ' lle' yog' nación, na' beṉ' chṉe wde wdeli dill'.

Na' yog'ḻoḻ beṉ'ka' lle' yell-lioni, beṉ'ka' bi da' leinna' ḻee libr c̱he Jesucrístona', we'la'ogake' bayix̱aa. Ḻa' kana' wxe wzilte yell-lioni, Jesucrístona', Beena' Zaklebi to Xil'do' daa betgake'ne', bzeje' ḻee libr c̱he'na' le yog' beṉ'ka' gat' yeḻ' mban c̱heyin zejḻi kaṉi.
Beena' cheni dga nia', chiyaḻ' wzenagyeṉeen.
Beena' wc̱he'gake' wsejgake', shajshaze' gatee lillyana'. Na' beena' ba nakan guetile' yesyana', guetshazile'n. Na' daan, beṉ'ka' nak lo na' Chioza' chiyaḻ' soac̱hec̱hgake' gonḻilall'gake'ne'.
Na'tech ble'id' sto bayix̱' bchejb ḻoo yell-liona' na' llia c̱hop ḻozb dii nak ka c̱he to xil'do', per chṉeb ka bayix̱' xṉana'.
Na' wdapb do ka nak yeḻ' wṉabia' c̱he bayix̱' necha', na' ba necha' be'b latj wṉabia'b kwenc̱he bem byen yog' beṉ' lle' yell-lioni be'la'ogake' ba necha', bana' biyaki we' c̱heba' daa nan guetib.
Na' ḻekzka' bana' bchej ḻoo yell-liona' bem yeḻ' wak xen daa benan ka bibani beṉ', ax̱t bem ka betj yi' xan yabana' bxopan lo yell-lioni chwiate beṉ' yell-lioka'.

Na' ni c̱he yeḻ' wakki gok lo na'b gom gana' llia ba necha', wxiye'b beṉ'ka' lle' yell-lioni kwenc̱he bzenaggake' c̱he ba necha', na' bem byen bengake' to lwaa lsak' ba necha' bana' biyaki we' c̱heba' daa bsalj yesyana'.
Na' bayix̱' wchopina' wdapb yeḻ' wak kwenc̱he wloob bishbe daa nak lwaa lsak' bayix̱' necha', kwenc̱he gak iṉen na' gonan ka witgake' yog' beṉ'ka' bi we'la'o ḻen.

Na' ḻekzka' bem byen yog'ḻoḻ beṉ' sho' nee de shḻina' wa loxgue'na' to seṉ, ka beṉ' zakii ka beṉ' bi zakii, ka beṉ' wni'a ka beṉ' yesh', ka beṉ' ndoo lla yel chone' xshin beṉ' na' ka beṉ' chon xshinkze'.
Na' kono gok wit' wde bi dii de c̱he' wa si'e bi dii chyalljile' shi bi yo'e seṉ c̱he bayix̱aa daa nak leb wa número daa zeji leba'.
Chyalljicho yeḻ' sin' kwenc̱he shajniicho dga. Beena' shajniile'n na' yiyiljni'e número c̱he bayix̱aa daa nak to número c̱he beṉ'. Na' númerona' nakan x̱op guiyoa guiyon x̱op.
